task: payment wallet unlock entitlement launch hardening

summary.sourceTruth: server-confirmed PayPal capture, Firestore transaction ledger, secure content proxy entitlement

findings.title: PayPal capture identity binding was optional
findings.risk: A completed capture payload without the server-created custom_id could credit the authenticated caller without proving the order was created for that user/package.
findings.fix: Capture now requires the PayPal custom_id and checks both user id and expected Gum Drops before any Firestore credit or payment lock write.
tests: tests/unit/paypal-capture-route.spec.ts rejects completed captures that are missing the server-created custom id
tests/unit/paypal-capture-route.spec.ts rejects captures whose custom id does not match the requested package

findings.title: Secure content proxy did not mirror creator entitlement
findings.risk: The viewer client treated creators as authorized for their own drop, but the content proxy only accepted unlocked buyers.
findings.fix: The secure content proxy now accepts either a verified unlock or creator ownership before proxying private media.
tests: tests/unit/drops-content-route.spec.ts blocks locked content for a caller without entitlement
tests/unit/drops-content-route.spec.ts serves content after the user has unlocked the drop
tests/unit/drops-content-route.spec.ts treats the drop creator as entitled without requiring a paid unlock

findings.title: Money/access ledger rows needed stronger audit detail
findings.risk: Admin balance adjustments and unlock spend records were server-authenticated but had limited structured evidence for parity/debug checks.
findings.fix: Admin adjustments now include admin uid/email/reason/source/audited marker. Unlock transactions include unlock source and purchased/reward spend split.
tests: tests/unit/admin-balance-route.spec.ts verifies structured admin adjustment audit fields

surfaces.serverConfirmedCompletion: order creation requires authenticated user and trusted origin; server helper writes userId:expectedDrops custom_id
PayPal capture status, USD amount, package price, and custom_id user/package binding are checked before credit
read-only package list; capture route revalidates package amount and price

surfaces.idempotencyMechanism: unlockedContent check inside Firestore transaction before deduction

surfaces.requiredFix: allow creator ownership in secure proxy
test coverage for non-purchase revenue exclusion
